x: And lastly, after a very successful season, at the Guardian Gold Cup Final in Bedford, our Patron Sir Eddie Kulukundis, OBE., who has taken a great interest in Matthew's sporting career, had pleasure in presenting a very excited young man with a new racing wheelchair that he had kindly donated.

And of course Sir Eddie Kulukundis was a fixture to his seat throughout the Championships. Clive did manage to chat to Mark Shearman a couple of times and mentioned that we'd like a copy of a photo of Tom for The Belgravian.

Many of our young athletes and their parents came along and we welcomed special guests in the personages of Sir Eddie Kulukundis OBE (our Club Patron), John Hadley (Representative of The Sports Council), Mike Da Silva (Chairman of the National Young Athletes League) and of course our Club President Ted Pallant.
In this Sir Eddie Kulukundis funded combined events meet Du'aine Ladejo took advantage of the strong winds to clock a spectacular 100 metre time and set a handy 7635 points in his maiden Decathlon.
He has also played for Harlequins and Coventry. Congratulations to Sir Eddie Kulukundis who was re-elected as Vice-President of U.K.

…rs, Excellence and Honours distributed among the 80-odd attendees by Eric Hall (Belgrave President) and his wife Mavis, Sir Eddie Kulukundis OBE (Patron), Jacqui Smiter (Women's Team Manager), Jon Lambert (Young Athletes Team Manager), Bill Laws and John Jeffery (British League Team Managers).…

And finally, thanks to all our supporters, both present and future, and above all to our number one fan, Sir Eddie Kulukundis, who attends every meet and who always puts supporting our Teams at the top of his busy and very full schedule.
